why.title: Designed for little hands and busy campuses

items.title: Right for every age group
items.text: Ranges for ages 3+ and 5–12, so pre-primary and primary children each get equipment sized for them.

items.title: Built for daily use
items.text: Galvanized pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, chosen to stand up to every recess.

items.title: Free campus layout
items.text: Share your ground or terrace plan. We suggest a layout that fits the space, the age groups and your budget.

items.title: Made in our own factory
items.text: Manufactured at our 45,000 sq. ft. facility in Vasai, with 24+ years of experience behind every unit.

items.title: Installed around your calendar
items.text: Installation planned around your school calendar, so classes carry on without disruption.

items.title: 3-year structural warranty
items.text: 3 years on galvanized pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. 1 year on springs and bearings.

ranges.title: Play structures sized for every age group

tabs.name: FunPlay Originals
tabs.blurb: Our own designs, inspired by Indian play, nature and paper craft. Each one invites children to invent their own games.

tabs.name: CoreCraft
tabs.blurb: Themed multi-play stations (castles, circus, jungle, robots), plus individual swings, slides, see-saws and spring riders.

tabs.name: NexLev Series
tabs.blurb: Wooden play structures: pinnacle towers, castles and adventure sets for large communities and campuses.
